result_text:
The parent report now survives a sub-landscape whose `config.json` is missing or unreadable.

**Change:** `reports/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/landscape/statichtml/LandscapeReportGenerator.java`, in `addSubLandscapeSection` (around line 653). When `getSubLandscapeConfig` returns `null`, the code now falls back to `new Metadata()` instead of calling `getMetadata()` on `null`. A fresh `Metadata` has no logo link, so the row takes the existing default branch: the `landscape.png` icon, still wrapped in the link to the sub-landscape's index page. Rows with a readable config keep their own logo, and the figures columns are unchanged. The existing `getSubLandscapeConfig` already catches read failures and returns `null`, so no change was needed there.

**Verification:** `mvn -o -pl reports test` builds and passes (one existing test). No test covers the report generator, so I did not reproduce the NPE end to end with a broken sub-landscape. I did not touch `LandscapeAnalyzer`, which also reads sub-landscape `config.json` files at line 247; I didn't check whether that path can fail the same way.

Nothing is committed.
